earlier_identifications: Earlier public TESS-SPOC full-frame threshold-crossing events and Kostov et al. (2025) unvetted machine list
interpretation: Five sectors show the primary on a variable baseline. The secondary passes the event test in two sectors. The primary difference centroid in sector 84 lies 11 arcsec from the target. ASAS-SN V detects the primary.
additional_tables: No exact TIC in Tang et al. 514-source table and no positional or TIC hit in the 280 spectroscopic EB table.
